! --- SNMP (read-only; managed by tacctl) ---
! Credentials: this scope's own (tacctl scope snmp lab show --reveal).
! Allowed clients: the tacctl server first, the scope's ranges, then everything else (0.0.0.0/0) refused.
! If TACCTL-SNMP already exists on the device, its old lines stay: 'no ip access-list standard TACCTL-SNMP' first.
ip access-list standard TACCTL-SNMP
  permit host 10.0.0.42
  permit 198.51.100.0 0.0.0.255
  remark everything else (0.0.0.0/0) is refused
  deny   any
!
! SHA-256 for SNMPv3 users needs a release that has it; the keyword is not verified on a device.
snmp-server view TACCTL-VIEW iso included
snmp-server group TACCTL-GROUP v3 priv read TACCTL-VIEW access TACCTL-SNMP
snmp-server user tacctl-ro TACCTL-GROUP v3 auth sha256 auth-pass-0123 priv aes 128 priv-pass-4567
!
snmp-server location Rack 4, DC1
snmp-server contact NOC <noc@example.net>
! Check from the tacctl server: tacctl scope snmp lab test <device-address>   (expects sysName 'core-sw1')
